name: Contribution Margin Cost-Volume-Profit Analysis Calculator
meta_title: Contribution Margin CVP Calculator for Multiple Products
meta_description: Run cost-volume-profit analysis for a multi-product sales mix: weighted contribution margin, breakeven by product, margin of safety and operating leverage.
subtitle: Enter up to four products with their prices, variable costs and expected volumes to find the weighted contribution margin, breakeven sales for the whole mix and each product, and how strongly profit reacts to a change in sales.
